• Handle a “berce” using a mechanical arm (loading, transport and unloading)
• Be driven with a “large goods vehicle” license
• Be compatible with the climatic conditions of French Guiana.
• Transport 3 people in a seated position
• Be equipped with a diesel engine with a minimum power of 220hp
